# Swing ConneXion

> Swing dance school in Montréal, Québec, Canada. Founded in 2005, celebrating 20 years of swing dance on the Plateau Mont-Royal.

Swing ConneXion (SCX) teaches Lindy Hop, Balboa, and Charleston to all levels — from total beginners to advanced social dancers and performers. Classes are held at the studio at 1483 avenue du Mont-Royal Est, 3e étage, Montréal (H2J 1Z5).

## What We Offer

- **Group classes** — Lindy Hop, Balboa, and Charleston at all levels, running in multi-week sessions throughout the year
- **Private lessons** — one-on-one or couple coaching with SCX instructors
- **Weekly intro class** — free swing intro every Wednesday at 19h at Café La Ligne Verte (2531 Ontario Est), followed by three sets of live jazz
- **Mercredis Swing** — Montreal's weekly live jazz and swing dance night, running since 2007, every Wednesday at Café La Ligne Verte
- **Performance troupes** — dedicated rehearsal groups for dancers pursuing Lindy Hop and Balboa performance
